violation_type.title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Recognize and Respect Children's Uniqueness and Potential (26 TAC §746.1201(3))
violation_type.short_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Recognize and Respect Children's Uniqueness and Potential
violation_type.typical_finding: Based on the information obtained throughout the investigation, it was determined that the facility disregarded the need of the children for services by excluding them from attending daycare by asking parent to keep them at home and bring them back after an evaluation being done at the facility due to the oldest child?s behavior.

finding_variants.text: Based on the information obtained throughout the investigation, it was determined that the facility disregarded the need of the children for services by excluding them from attending daycare by asking parent to keep them at home and bring them back after an evaluation being done at the facility due to the oldest child?s behavior.
This standard was evaluated as part of an investigation and found to be deficient. Responsibility of the caregiver was not met.
This standard was reviewed as part of an investigation and found deficient. It was determined caregivers failed to relate to children with respect when disciplining them.
A caregiver was observed communicating with a child in an agressive tone and threatening to put the child in time out if she didn't behave immediately.

Video evidence collected during this investigation showed a caregiver repeatedly mistreat an individual child in care while interacting more positively with other children.  The child was observed upset and seeking comfort from the caregiver who repeatedly pushed her away with her hands and feet.
